notes.title: Steam Workshop support has been confirmed!
notes.content:
[h3][i]Bright Memory: Infinite[/i] Mod Workshop support is currently in the works.[/h3]

[h3][i]Secluded Orchid[/i], a tech demo made with Unreal Engine 5, is available now! While there are no plans of a [i]Bright Memory: Infinite[/i] remake made with Unreal Engine 5, FYQD Studio plans on utilizing Unreal Engine 5 in their upcoming works. Please look forward to what they have in store and stay tuned![/h3]

[h3]Tech Demo: Secluded Orchid[/h3]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5kJljpC5sHE

[i]Secluded Orchid[/i]  was made by pure coincidence while I was out of the house one day. The 3D scenes took roughly 2 hours and 5000 8K photos, which were then used to make high quality 3D models and were eventually imported into Unreal Engine 5,  it took a total of 15 days to make the arm model, control, cutscene animation and UI design.

This is the first time we have ever used a motion capture system in our projects. The motions used in the demo took about 20 minutes to prepare so the quality is still a little rough around the edges. At the time we were using an inertial sensor motion capture system which has improved efficiency compared to manual keyframe animation. However, it falls a little short in accuracy compared to optical motion capture systems so we are looking into working with those in the future.

notes.title: Bright Memory: Inifinite Releasing on November 11 PDT!
notes.content:
[h3]It's been a three-year wait but the much anticipated Bright Memory: Infinite is finally coming to Steam on November 11 PDT! Don't forget to check out the epic new trailer below. There will also be a gameplay video dropping soon, so please stay tuned![/h3]

[h3]Latest Trailer[/h3]
https://youtu.be/5K5mMGR5CDo

[h3]Developer Comment[/h3]
For Bright Memory: Infinite, I wanted to focus on adding content to give players a more satisfying experience. As a result, development took three times as long as Bright Memory. This process allowed me to learn how to create a strong game while dealing with time and financial constraints. I spent a lot of time thinking of ways to maximize whatever technology and resources available to me in order to deliver an unforgettable experience through the game. As such, Bright Memory: Infinite represents the culmination of FYQD Studio's growth. Finally, I would like to express my gratitude to all my global partners and those who have provided technical support to me. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381617/f3bf83f7265a5b005b22c7c8f9a1d74be05fc4a9.jpg[/img]

[h3]Game Features[/h3]
Bright Memory: Infinite features support for 21:9 ultra-wide monitor display, fifth generation TAA, as well as optimization for Xbox controllers. With NVIDIA providing technical support throughout development in the form of ray tracing, DLSS, NVIDIA Relfex support, and the minimization of lag time, Bright Memory: Infinite promises to deliver the ultimate gaming experience to all gamers out there.

notes.title: New Trailer for Bright Memory: Infinite!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Users,
We have a new trailer for Bright Memory: Infinite, which is featured by Bilibili on its online event.[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1178830/_/

[h3]Trailer Review[/h3]
https://youtu.be/-D6l3Y7caG4


In Bright Memory: Infinite, players can acquire different weapons as the game and story progress. This video shows the special firing mode of each respective weapon. In the middle and later stages of the game, players will get a sniper gun. The special bullets of the sniper gun contain a viscous explosive, which can stick to the surface of any object - including enemies. Once this explosive has latched on, it explodes, causing devastating shrapnel damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381617/789b732910f8e08c660ae2525aa2bb2e7dcd1745.jpg[/img]

In addition, the video also features a demo of a boss battle included in the later stages of the game. The player takes on the “Mysterious Masked Man” (later discovered to be Tian Yu Emperor) in the Hanging Temple at an altitude of 20,000 meters. The player must race to the top of the mountain and use their grapple to latch onto a crashing airplane in order to reach the Hanging City, which is suspended by the immense gravity of the black hole.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381617/c1397d10f8d09fbc96f5cdd83765375dc2d9ddd5.jpg[/img]

Players are always concerned about the facial model of the heroine, Shelia. After collecting feedback from players, FYQD Studio has optimized Shelia’s face once again. The following is a display image, showing a comparison with an image from last year's build. The new model has some added freckles and a mole on her face, and the various facial features have been adjusted. The high-precision face modeling technology used for General Lin was developed late in the schedule and with the tight development time, Shelia’s face has not yet been upgraded to show off the same fine detail as General Lin, but the developer continues to further optimize these various elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381617/e5b750fa280aa40b92926283325418c3ca3eb7f5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381617/432694fbedcaddfe5d3a78f55724c16d9ab9bf33.jpg[/img]

[h3]Development for Bright Memory: Infinite has entered its final phase, with voice recording, music creation, porting, and debugging currently progressing ahead of its release later in 2021. Users who purchase Bright Memory on Steam before the release of Bright Memory: Infinite will be eligible to receive Bright Memory: Infinite for free.[/h3]
